routing_decisions.name: classify_customer_intent
routing_decisions.routing_rationale: Closed-taxonomy intent classification with fixed output categories. Composite score 1.85 is well within MECHANICAL tier. Zero inferential steps — direct pattern match against six predefined categories. High confidence.

routing_decisions.name: lookup_account_status
routing_decisions.routing_rationale: Pure data retrieval via Salesforce CRM tool call. Composite score 1.45 — lowest in the batch. No reasoning required beyond issuing a well-formed API call and passing back the response. Output precision is high (must not modify values) but that is a constraint, not a complexity driver.

routing_decisions.name: fill_ticket_template
routing_decisions.routing_rationale: All template slots map directly to values present verbatim in the context. Slot-filling with no inference. Composite 1.40. Output precision is high because this feeds downstream systems, but the task itself is mechanical.

routing_decisions.name: transcribe_call_summary
routing_decisions.routing_rationale: Extraction task — the model reads a transcript and pulls out explicitly stated facts into a structured format. Composite 2.30 sits firmly in MECHANICAL. Ambiguity is low-medium (some transcript passages need interpretation of what was agreed) but not high enough to push to STANDARD. Confidence 0.92 is above the 0.70 threshold.

routing_decisions.name: generate_personalized_empathy_response
routing_decisions.routing_rationale: Requires tone calibration, brand voice adherence, and contextual empathy — none of which are mechanical. Composite 3.65 crosses the STANDARD threshold. Reasoning depth 4 confirms Sonnet minimum. Output must pass human tone review, demanding coherent generation beyond Haiku's reliable capability for emotionally charged text.

routing_decisions.name: determine_refund_eligibility_edge_case
routing_decisions.routing_rationale: Edge case at the top of the STANDARD range (composite 5.30). Reasoning depth 6 is the ceiling for Sonnet. The customer's mitigating circumstance (no notification email) requires policy interpretation beyond simple application. Safety criticality 5 is below the safety-critical floor trigger (>=7). Sonnet is the appropriate choice — this does not rise to Opus territory unless escalation occurs.

escalation_path.note: If Sonnet's determination is challenged or shows incomplete policy reasoning, escalate to Opus immediately.

routing_decisions.name: analyze_fraud_pattern_in_dispute
routing_decisions.routing_rationale: Highest-stakes task in the batch. Composite 7.85 and reasoning_depth 8 unambiguously place this in DEEP tier. Safety_criticality 9 triggers the safety-critical override independently, ensuring Opus floor. Output feeds an irreversible account suspension decision. Cross-signal analysis (geo + device + velocity + behavioral history) demands expert-level synthesis that Sonnet cannot reliably deliver.
routing_decisions.safety_critical_override_reason: safety_criticality=9 >= 7 threshold; account suspension is irreversible

escalation_path.note: If Opus output confidence is low, escalate to human fraud analyst. No further model escalation possible.

routing_decisions.name: draft_legal_compliance_email
routing_decisions.routing_rationale: GDPR Article 17 response requires deep legal domain expertise across multiple sub-articles (data retention basis, legitimate interest, legal obligation), jurisdiction-specific regulatory contacts, and zero-error precision (output_precision=10). Any error exposes the company to DPA enforcement action. Safety_criticality 9 independently triggers safety-critical override. Domain_expertise 9 confirms DEEP.

escalation_path.note: All GDPR responses should be reviewed by legal counsel before sending, regardless of model output quality.

routing_decisions.name: resolve_multi_system_data_conflict
routing_decisions.routing_rationale: Three-way state conflict requiring event-sourcing reasoning across CRM, billing, and product databases with contradictory timestamps. Composite 7.80 is firmly DEEP. Multi_step_planning 8 reflects the need to sequence root-cause analysis before producing a remediation plan. Safety_criticality 7 triggers the safety-critical override (floor: Sonnet), though DEEP already exceeds this. Wrong remediation corrupts all three downstream systems.
routing_decisions.safety_critical_override_reason: safety_criticality=7 >= 7; erroneous remediation corrupts production data

escalation_path.note: Data integrity remediation plans should be reviewed by a backend engineer before execution.

routing_decisions.name: suggest_upsell_opportunity
routing_decisions.routing_rationale: Composite 3.50 sits at the bottom of the STANDARD range. Requires product knowledge synthesis and tone calibration for a non-pushy recommendation. Haiku would likely produce a generic recommendation without the nuance needed for customer retention context. Safety_criticality 1 — no risk. Sonnet provides the brand-voice quality needed for customer-facing text.

escalation_path.note: Escalation to Opus is unlikely to be warranted for an upsell suggestion. A single escalation cap is appropriate.

routing_decisions.name: orchestrate_crm_update_workflow
routing_decisions.routing_rationale: Multi-tool orchestration across Salesforce, payment processor, and SendGrid with ordered dependencies and partial-failure handling. Multi_step_planning 6 is the dominant driver. Safety_criticality 5 (financial transaction) is below the safety-critical floor trigger but warrants Sonnet over Haiku. Composite 4.40 confirms STANDARD.

escalation_path.note: If payment tool call fails and recovery logic is needed, Opus may be warranted for complex error handling.

routing_decisions.name: summarize_case_history_for_escalation
routing_decisions.routing_rationale: Synthesis across 6 interaction records with pattern identification and implicit commitment tracking. Composite 4.35 in mid-STANDARD range. Reasoning depth 5 requires connecting dots across records that Haiku would likely miss. Output is read by a human expert (tier-2 agent), so precision matters. Not safety-critical enough for Opus.

with_routing.note: Actual total reflects the mix. Haiku tasks are near-zero cost; Opus tasks dominate despite being only 3 of 12.
